critical_code_review_comments: currency.py: start_background_refresh uses asyncio.get_event_loop() which is deprecated in Python 3.10+; on Python 3.12 it will emit DeprecationWarning. Prefer asyncio.get_running_loop() inside an async context (i.e. call start_background_refresh from within the FastAPI startup event coroutine where a loop is already running).

currency.py: CurrencyConverter._refresh_loop has no exception isolation around asyncio.sleep — if cancellation happens the task dies silently. Wrap the loop body in try/except asyncio.CancelledError and log; otherwise re-raise.

routes/payouts_live.py stripe_webhook handler catches plain `Exception` for verify_webhook failures (line 81-83). When provider.verify_webhook raises RuntimeError('Stripe Connect is not configured'), the caller gets 400 'Invalid signature' which is misleading (already flagged in iter8). Use `except RuntimeError -> 503; except Exception -> 400`.

routes/outfits.py: GET /outfits/{outfit_id} reads deps.db directly via .find_one(); rest of module delegates to deps.outfit_generator. Inconsistent layering — move this query into outfit_generator.get_outfit() for testability.
routes/affiliate.py: track_click endpoint relies on request.client.host for IP, but behind ingress this is the proxy IP not the real client. Honour X-Forwarded-For header for fraud_service IP checks.

deps.py: get_current_user is typed Optional[Callable] and read with await — if startup ordering ever fails to set it, every route raises 'NoneType is not callable' (500). Add a guard at startup that asserts deps.get_current_user is set before include_router runs, or fall back to a safer default that raises 503 'Auth not initialised'.
server.py is still 3211 lines — continue the extraction pattern (auth, posts, rewards, users) into routes/*. Iteration 9 only extracted 4 routers.
